summary: This bill lowers from 16 to 14 the age at which minors in the District of Columbia can be excluded from Family Court jurisdiction and transferred to adult criminal proceedings for certain offenses by amending sections 16-2301 and 16-2307 of the D.C. Official Code, applying to crimes committed after enactment.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly addresses criminal justice by lowering the age at which individuals can be tried as adults for certain offenses in DC, indicating a move towards stricter justice for younger offenders. This is the central focus of the bill.
